text: At its meeting of April 27, 2018, the Employee and Labour Relations Committee considered the report (April 3, 2018) from the Executive Director, Human Resources on Occupational Health and Safety Report - End of Year 2017.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the End of Year 2017 Occupational Health and Safety Report (April 3, 3018) from the Executive Director, Human Resources for information.
